product_overview: Muttu Hub is a web platform for managing customer relationships, team tasks, documents, and reporting in one place. It centralizes CRM records, Kanban work, document storage, and dashboard summaries for authenticated users.
core_goals: Sign in to access the platform and recover a forgotten password
Manage customer and partner records in a CRM with searchable lists and detailed profiles
Track team work on a Kanban board with task creation and status updates
Store, search, download, and organize versioned documents
Generate operational reports and export them to Excel or PDF
Administer users, roles, and access control for the organization
Review dashboard summaries for pipeline, tasks, client activity, and personal workload

features.name: User Login and Password Recovery
features.description: Users authenticate with email and password, and can start a password reset flow if they cannot sign in.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter an invalid email-password combination -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an access error message

Navigate to /login -> Select the password reset option -> Navigate to /auth/reset-password -> Request a reset email -> Navigate to /auth/reset-password/confirm -> Set a new password -> Sign in successfully

features.name: Dashboard Summaries
features.description: Users review their main work summary, including commitments, tasks, pipeline, and client activity.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review daily commitments summary -> Review pipeline status -> Review tasks due today -> Review client activity
Navigate to / -> Review personal task summary -> Review personal client commitments -> Review assigned clients and their status

features.name: Customer Management (CRM)
features.description: Users manage customers and partners, including searching the list, opening records, creating new clients, editing details, deleting records, and exporting a printable list.
user_flows: Navigate to /clientes -> Review the customer list -> Search by name -> Open a customer detail sheet -> Review client information
Navigate to /clientes -> Create a new customer -> Fill in the required customer details -> Save the record -> See the new customer in the list
Navigate to /clientes -> Open a customer detail sheet -> Edit customer data -> Save changes -> See the updated record
Navigate to /clientes -> Open a customer detail sheet -> Delete the customer -> Confirm the action -> See the record removed from the active list
Navigate to /clientes -> Open the customer list -> Export the printable customer list -> See the printable output

features.name: Team Kanban Board
features.description: Users manage team tasks on a drag-and-drop Kanban board, including creating and editing tasks and opening a task report view.
user_flows: Navigate to /tablero -> Review tasks grouped by status columns -> Drag a task to another column -> See the task status change
Navigate to /tablero -> Create a new task -> Fill in the task title -> Assign a responsible person -> Save the task -> See the task on the board
Navigate to /tablero -> Open a task -> Edit task details -> Save changes -> See the updated task information
Navigate to /tablero -> Open the task report view -> Review task progress by status and team

features.name: Document Repository
features.description: Users upload documents, search stored files, download individual documents, and download multiple documents as a ZIP file.
user_flows: Navigate to /documentos -> Review the document list with metadata -> Search documents by name or metadata -> Open the matching document
Navigate to /documentos -> Upload a new document -> Add document details -> Save the upload -> See the document in the repository
Navigate to /documentos -> Open a document -> Download the document -> Receive the file
Navigate to /documentos -> Select multiple documents -> Download documents as ZIP -> Receive the compressed file

features.name: Reports and Exports
features.description: Users select a report and export task and dashboard reports to Excel or PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /reportes -> Review report selection -> Generate a task report -> Export the report to Excel -> Receive the spreadsheet
Navigate to /reportes -> Review report selection -> Generate a task report -> Export the report to PDF -> Receive the document

features.name: Administration (Users and Roles)
features.description: Administrators manage users, assign roles, deactivate access, and maintain catalogs and permissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /administracion -> Review the user list -> Create a new user -> Assign a role -> Save the user -> See the user in the list
Navigate to /administracion -> Open a user record -> Assign or change the user's role -> Save changes -> See the updated access level
Navigate to /administracion -> Open a user record -> Deactivate user access -> Confirm the action -> See the user marked as inactive
Navigate to /administracion -> Open the catalogs section -> Manage catalogs -> Save updates -> See the catalog changes
